dailyChallenge.question: Which of these is the best definition of "Data Center"?
choices: The process of an already-trained AI model actually being used to produce an answer, as opposed to the earlier process of training it.
The field that combines engineering and AI to build physical machines that can sense their surroundings and act in the real world.
When an AI system confidently states information that is false, made up, or not actually supported by its sources.
A large facility packed with computer servers, used to store data and run large-scale computing tasks, including training and running AI models.
dailyChallenge.explanation: A large facility packed with computer servers, used to store data and run large-scale computing tasks, including training and running AI models. The massive data center construction boom driven by AI is reshaping energy use, local economies, and environmental debates worldwide.

dailyActivity.title: Translate confusing fine print into plain English
dailyActivity.learningObjective: How to understand terms, contracts, or technical text before agreeing to them.
dailyActivity.tryThis: Explain what this actually means for me in plain English, and flag anything that seems like it could matter: [paste text].
dailyActivity.whyItWorks: Dense legal or technical language is often simpler than it looks once it's restated plainly — just don't skip reading it entirely.
